text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David (beloved). 1 Answer me when I call, O God {Elohe} of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you⁺ love vanity and seek after lies (false gods) Selah
Know that the LORD {YHWH} has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
Be angry, yet do not sin (In your anger do not sin); on your⁺ bed, search your⁺ heart and be still. Selah
Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD {YHWH}.
Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD {YHWH}.
You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD {YHWH}, make me dwell in safety.
